subject: Security

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: CI workflow runs no secret scanner before merge

evidence.excerpt: - name: Restore dependencies ... - name: Build ... - name: Test (no secret-scanning step)

findings.standard: OWASP Secrets Management Cheat Sheet — SMG-05
findings.recommendation: Add a secret-detection step (e.g. a CI secret scanner or pre-commit hook) to the pull-request workflow so credentials in appsettings*.json or code are caught before merge.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Test-data reset endpoint is exposed in every environment on the public listener

evidence.excerpt: /// A controller for testing management operations. ... [Route("v{version:apiVersion}/[controller]")] [AllowAnonymous]

findings.standard: OWASP REST Security Cheat Sheet — ORS-01
findings.recommendation: Register the testing controller only in Development/test environments (or move it to a separate, network-restricted host or port); per SCR-01, production builds should not ship test-management routes.

checkResults.subject: Security
